method: Fresh read of all changed production/test diff, complete proxy_transaction state machine and CLI lock/dispatch/menu caller boundaries; every six current file hashes and author evidence hashes verified. No test repetition.
checks: enable only retains selected core/configuration/port/directDomains and flips enabled; no import/download/preparation calls.
Current canonical selection and capability validation precede no-op/journal; saved enabled is no-op; unconfigured rejects before preparation/stop.
Existing private journal snapshots, idle checks, core/prerequisite checks, generated unit verification, compensation and old/candidate recovery remain unchanged.
CLI enable accepts confirmation only; server-only manager allowlist excludes it. Menu reuses saved materials with explicit confirmation; already enabled/missing config never write.
Tests cover disabled direct-list edit retained through enable, no-op, rollback, preflight refusal and failed start compensation.
limits: Static independent delta review, not a complete repository audit.
Retained existing services/nft/upstream substitutions; no new real Xray check or online mutation.
Original one fixture failure remains in author report and is not relabeled.
Shared-auth operator wording checked against public contract; this does not independently review my own shared-auth implementation.
